summary: Iteration 156: Fundraiser Field Structure Fix (Part 3). Backend: 27/27 tests pass (100%). Frontend: All scenarios verified. The critical bug fix — 'Fundraiser Name' now maps to fundraiser_name (NOT event_name) in apply-answers SAFE_MAP — is verified and working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: QuestionnaireResponseCreate model requires 'questionnaire_id' in body (not just in URL). Test confirmed this is enforced — any client submitting questionnaire must include questionnaire_id in the JSON body alongside answers.
apply-answers is idempotent and safe to call multiple times — confirmed via tests.

handleSaveFundraiserSettings in Webstores.js calls loadData() after save which reloads the webstore list. The selectedStore state is updated via setSelectedStore() before loadData(). On subsequent modal open, the fundraiserEdits state is correctly initialized from the fresh store data. This flow works correctly.
Progress bar toggle properly shows as enabled (not disabled) when goal_amount=3000 and disabled when goal_amount=0/empty — correct behavior as per spec.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fundraiser Field Structure Fix (Part 3) fully tested and verified.
